authority.user: Existing explicit design/control here and implementation in adjacent conversation; latest user identified the mutual-wait deadlock. Resolve the known verification gap and dispatch the previously authorized next step.

objective: Repair the already-frozen lower-z live/canonical correctness evidence and bound its cold transport, without changing product rendering or weakening its oracle.
non_goals: No new browser runs/main matrix in this repair slice
No official P34 or performance PASS
required_analysis: Current Runtime owns transform/snapping and selection decoration; SDK remains root public facade.
Pixel candidate is an actual framebuffer; reference remains the existing independent native CPU geometry/AA oracle, never candidate pixels.
Cold transport and paired fixture work must be separated from product latency and primary sampling.

live_reference_contract.fixture_unchanged: Existing257-point round-handdrawn-v4 stroke, rectangle from(280,150)to(540,370), lower-z selected stroke, down(100,100), move/up(124,112), fixed camera scale1,x0,y0.
live_reference_contract.expected_transform: Before selection bounds B and identity transform are required. Expected tx=24; ty=260-(B.top+B.bottom)/2. This is the fixed center-alignment fixture expectation, not a general reimplementation of snapping. Expected committed matrix[1,0,0,1,24,ty].
live_reference_contract.applicability: Same document, selected stroke ID, two object identities/order, unchanged camera/DPR across live capture and post-Up reference. Capture before/live/after public state. Before/live generation unchanged; afterUp exactly one transform commit, activeContacts0, canonical completion. The public after transform and native-decoded snapshot object transform must match the independent expected matrix within1e-4logical units. Wrong fixture rejects; no adaptive movement/search.
live_reference_contract.reference: Use actual afterUp opaque snapshot through unchanged native pixel oracle for live candidate only after subject checks; the expected move and same final pointer position define the target state. Snapshot remains original bytes; no candidate-derived geometry. If the live body differs from that expected state outside permitted HUD/reference AA, retain FAILED.

hud.source: Only fixed fixture geometry plus archived/current public selection bounds, camera and viewport metrics; never candidate colors/difference support.
hud.rotation_support: center x +/-7logicalpx; from top-38 through top.38 covers32px gap+4px grip+stroke/AA support.
hud.live_bounds: Project original public bounds and the independent expected translated bounds. Do not blindly add raw pointer delta12 or use post-state to choose a convenient expected transform.
hud.live_guide: Only lower-z step0: horizontal fixed fixture alignment y260 +/-2logicalpx, clipped to canvas width. At other steps no guide strip.
hud.hand_step: Read actual selection; use its public bounds if retained, including in hand mode. No assumption that tool change clears selection.

live_reference_contract.pixel_tolerance: UNCHANGED: <=2 channel levels outside independent native geometry AA edge and declared HUD; no compared pixels or HUD>20% ->MISSING; retained differences ->FAILED.
live_reference_contract.semantic_and_other_cases: Retain six original correctness cases and OFF/ON pairing rules, masks, transparency, background, resource pressure, DPR and feedback requirements. No PRODUCT_RED_IN_BOTH without complete matching pair.

cold_transport_and_stage_contract.scope: Correctness worker only. Primary timing/input scheduling, diagnostic/cohort/RT paths and public SDK remain unchanged.
cold_transport_and_stage_contract.representation: Bounded base64/binary-safe encoding is allowed across the verification host boundary. Existing snapshotChunk/pixelChunk can be invoked several times inside one page.evaluate, preserving each32KiB unit. Never return a document/frame-sized numeric JS array.
cold_transport_and_stage_contract.validation: Sequential exact offset/length, per-unit and batch bounds, exact final byte count and source/received SHA256; explicit finish/cancel ownership and no duplicate read. Pixel source hash is computed once in cold path if needed, not during primary sampling.
cold_transport_and_stage_contract.markers_rule: Coarse stage records only, not per pixel/sample. If render and readback remain one browser evaluate, add coarse browser markers in the existing correctnessDriver; do not claim exact await attribution beyond available brackets.
cold_transport_and_stage_contract.deadline: Keep original phase coverage and arm placement; ON/steps/batches never reset30s. A new timeout still closes its separately authorized future window.

initialization_profile_compatibility.old_profile: Preserve both original exact worker and consumer hashes. No migration of historical raw evidence.
initialization_profile_compatibility.new_profile: May add one exact repaired-worker profile, with the original consumer hash unchanged and helper/driver/pixel hashes pinned. Materialize final literal hashes before use in proof. Original createRuntime/server/shim/clock/raw collection and all non-correctness branches must be unchanged apart from imported cold-only helpers/correctness-gated code. No hash wildcard or accepting whatever current file exists.
initialization_profile_compatibility.paired_state: For the repaired correctness profile only, public init and paired_init may be distinct recorded state candidates. Match each initialization completion to a unique state by document+attachment+view+document epoch and the existing full owner/native chain. Enforce all current fresh-empty restrictions and count every accepted raw record.
initialization_profile_compatibility.historical_reuse: Original15 plus120/240 keep their exact recorded profiles and identities. All17 must recompile unchanged; repaired profile identity is a distinct applicability case, not historical source rewriting.

evidence_qualification.failure_mode: HUD or wrong live reference can report false render defects or hide actual order/alpha/mask/transform defects; cold extraction can exhaust a correctness deadline without identifying the stalled stage.
evidence_qualification.impact: Incorrect prerequisite admission or repeated premature stops prevent valid G5 performance comparison.
evidence_qualification.existing_independent_coverage: Native independent CPU geometry/AA oracle, semantic fixtures, actual OFF archives and original native render regressions.
evidence_qualification.residual_proof_gap: Same-subject live-vs-canonical applicability and candidate-independent HUD handling in the actual browser harness.
evidence_qualification.new_evidence_unique_detection_value: Real archived RED plus targeted body/order/alpha negatives establish that excluding known decorations does not exclude document errors; byte-exact transport tests protect captured evidence.
evidence_qualification.blocking_justification: Direct repair of the already-frozen six-case prerequisite; no new product closure target.
evidence_qualification.corroborative: Additional marker detail and cleaner failure text improve diagnosis; no independent product Gate is added for them.
